ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% low-intensity black central surface area versus 25% high-intensity white peripheral mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity black central region; dense white high-contrast spotting and mottling concentrated at the outer lateral tips and edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression; depth estimated at 1/15th of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular micro-serrations; significant macro-scale pixel-depth indentation (irregular notch) located on the medial trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges sweeping upwards to sharp distal tips; trailing edges follow an irregular, primarily concave curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the dark central regions and within the mottled white tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular macro-indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating significant tissue loss or previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced upward-curving 'hook' geometry at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
